authority: Source authorship only. No compilation, tests, native invocation, scan, repair, start, installation or release selection authorized.

scope.ownerBinding: Prior verified owner SID bound by SHA256; no personal name or SID literal persisted

counting: Reserve up to9 native returned entries before each1024B query. Charge root, dot entries and all returned entries before filtering/retaining. Failed or malformed batch keeps conservative reserved charge. Never silently page/resume.
publicEntry: Assess returns Incomplete/HeldForRootReview without native I/O. No CLI entry point or execution-enable flag.
deadline: Cooperative admission/continuation budget only. Synchronous native calls and cleanup can outlast15s. No permission to abandon ownership, kill, or claim a hard bound.
result: Aggregate counts/classifications + Complete/Incomplete/reason only. No names, paths, SIDs, per-object IDs, SDDL, content or exception messages exposed.
nativeAdmission: Open-existing metadata handles only; file handles request no READ_DATA
Normalized final path, NTFS volume/file ID, creation time, type, owner and reparse admission before DACL use/descent
Children open relative to retained admitted parent handle, with expected type and OPEN_REPARSE_POINT
Multi-link files, unsupported native/security records, access failure, owner mismatch and observed drift stop Incomplete
Protected directory DACLs stop traversal except the four independently targeted startup directories
completionSemantics: CompleteObservedTraversal means bounded exhaustion of the observed namespace under admitted handles; not an atomic namespace seal, historical root identity proof, custody proof, rollback baseline or repair authorization.
privacy: Transient metadata/paths only; no private file bodies, DB/profile/API opens, SDDL/messages, snapshots or rollback baseline persisted.

integrationList.requiredNext: Root/peer source review only; native ABI, batch parsing/counts, cleanup/drift and execution/custody plan remain unqualified.

patternProvenance.reused: Narrow SafeFileHandle, BY_HANDLE_FILE_INFORMATION and normalized-volume path patterns only
patternProvenance.newUnqualified: Handle-relative NtOpenFile, directory-batch enumeration, security-reader and complete traversal

releaseBoundary: Old exact backport remains held. Forward-source selection is a separate review of actual owned source and integration; source metadata version is not release proof.
